pipeline_stages.label: Acquire
pipeline_stages.description: Get the document — crawl, search, fetch, or upload.

pipeline_stages.description: Pull structure out of it: tables, sections, text.

pipeline_stages.description: Split into retrievable units with their context kept.

pipeline_stages.description: Apply controlled vocabulary so retrieval can filter.

pipeline_stages.description: Vectorise and index for semantic search.

pipeline_stages.label: Publish
pipeline_stages.description: Make it live in the corpus, and keep it fresh.
